remarks: Welcome home to this beautiful paired home in the highly sought-after Rancho San Rafael community, ideally situated on a cul-de-sac. Step through the front double doors to an expansive, open, airy floor plan designed for comfortable living. A soaring cathedral ceiling, oversized windows that fill the living space with abundant natural light, and a cozy fireplace create a warm and inviting atmosphere. The spacious kitchen features abundant cabinetry and stainless steel appliances, and it opens seamlessly to the dining area and an inviting family room. Step outside to your own private backyard.
